description: Somos un equipo del Colegio North School de Punta del Este. Programamos videojuego con Scratch.
summary:
Space missions are complex and hard for young kids to imagine.
We wanted to create a fun, visual simulator so children can experience what it feels like to travel to Mars and return safely to Earth.
Understanding the stages of a spaceflight inspires future astronauts and explorers.
details:
Our solution is a simulation created in the Scratch programming environment.

MISSION STAGES: STEP-BY-STEP

Launch & Ascent: A rocket blasts off, passing through the sky and atmospheric reentry fire into outer space.

Exploring Mars: From inside the cockpit, Mars grows closer until landing on the Martian surface.

Return & Splashdown: Heading back to Earth, passing through the sky to an ocean splashdown and astronaut recovery.
